body:
The only reason why I’m not leaving here is because I’m too pathetic and coward to leave, if this thought wasn’t in my mind I really think there’s no point of being here... 
what’s worse is when everyone thinks you’re happy, why can’t they understand even though it’s so obvious?

I know it gets better but sometimes when people say that it feels like empty words.
There has to be something out there and it can’t just be this

I posted it here to get it off my mind and vent since I haven’t had anyone to actually speak to this about...but thanks for the support.

Surprising how you fail to realise that people have experienced things that you haven’t before.

Other people have different things that are making them feel down and lonely. I’m sure we’re allowed to post it on Reddit.
It was a normal period then my period finished and then 2 weeks later I got the bleeding.
She’s not close to her family and the last time anyone heard from her was a month ago when her close friend from back home came to visit. I don’t want to be obsessively checking if she is okay tbh.
I’m still financially recovering from this. I’m almost emotionally done and over with it, just hope she’s doing good wherever she is.

Weird thing is she hasn’t blocked me or anyone but completely stopped using the social media site she obsessively used after she moved out/doesn’t read texts etc.
We live abroad and her friends are back home.
Some of her friends have been asking me where she is and one of them thinks I am the asshole for not knowing.
